user.title: Connect to your Reolink NVR or camera
user.description: Uses the Reolink Baichuan protocol (port 9000 by default) for two-way talk. Channels, names and talk support are discovered automatically; setup only makes read-only queries.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NVR, or of a standalone camera.
data_description.port: TCP port of the Baichuan service (9000 unless you changed it on the device).
data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device. It needs permission to use two-way talk.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address, port or credentials. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NVR, or of a standalone camera.
data_description.port: TCP port of the Baichuan service (9000 unless you changed it on the device).
data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

error.no_talk_channels: Connected, but every channel reports that it has no two-way talk support.

abort.wrong_device: The address now points to a different Reolink device. Add it as a new device instead.

init.title: AudioHook options
init.description: Channels, their state and talk support were re-scanned (read-only) when this dialog opened. Sleeping battery cameras are listed and are woken up when they need to speak. Channels without talk support: {unsupported}.

data_description.voice: Any Microsoft Edge neural voice name, for example en-US-JennyNeural or en-GB-RyanNeural.
data_description.volume: 100 % plays the audio unchanged; above 100 % amplifies (may clip).
data_description.enabled_channels: Speaker entities are created only for these cameras, and the actions refuse every other one.

invalid_auth.message: The device rejected the stored username or password.

not_a_speaker.message: {entity_id} is not a Reolink Camera AudioHook speaker.

target_required.message: Pass either a camera (speaker entity) or a channel.

entry_not_loaded.message: The NVR/camera entry {entry_id} does not exist or is not loaded.

no_entry_loaded.message: No Reolink Camera AudioHook device is set up and loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several devices are set up: pass a camera or the NVR (config entry) together with the channel.

channel_not_enabled.message: {name} (channel {channel}) is not allowed to talk. Enable it in the integration options.

channel_offline.message: {name} (channel {channel}) is reported offline by the NVR.

talk_timeout.message: {name} (channel {channel}) did not answer in time (it may be asleep or out of Wi-Fi range): {error}

nothing_to_play.message: Nothing to play: pass a message or a media item.

say.name: Say
say.description: Speak a message on a Reolink camera speaker using edge-tts.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Speaker entity of the camera. Use this or channel.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: NVR channel number (0-based). Use this or camera.

config_entry_id.name: NVR
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with channel when several NVRs or cameras are set up.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: edge-tts voice; overrides the default from the options.

play_file.name: Play file
play_file.description: Play an audio file, URL or media-source item (for example a TTS result) on a camera speaker.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Speaker entity of the camera. Use this or channel.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: NVR channel number (0-based). Use this or camera.

config_entry_id.name: NVR
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with channel when several NVRs or cameras are set up.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: media-source:// ID, http(s) URL, or a local path inside allowlist_external_dirs.
